values: Paper/demo/live trading model, dispatch chokepoints, MT5 state, and risk posture.
Paper, external MT5 demo, and live-money modes must be clearly labeled and mechanically distinct.
UI labels, ledger mode, MT5 is_demo flag, execution provenance, broker modes.
PAPER lane, PAPER_MT5 / MT5_DEMO_BROKER, and CURRENTLY NOT LICENSED live authority.
Keep execution source and live-money truth visible together so PAPER is not mistaken for internal simulation.
Read-only cached account/position mirror; no order sends from snapshot route. This does not restrict the AI Operator's execution authority.
The mirror observes; the autonomous bridge executes.

Terminal Algo Trading must be ON when CAS is expected to place, modify, or close MT5 demo orders and learn from broker acceptance, fills, slippage, rejection, stop-loss, and take-profit outcomes. With Algo Trading OFF, CAS may still observe real broker quotes and completed candles, but it cannot collect genuine MT5 execution outcomes. The app must surface the terminal, account, expert-trading, and trade-API permission truth without implying that quote observation alone proves execution learning.
Do not represent quote observation as broker-execution learning when Algo Trading is off.
All broker-bound orders must pass order dispatch and execution guard.

The AI Operator reviews each exact fresh RouteIntent candidate and decides APPROVE or STAND_DOWN. Approval is an executable entry decision, not an advisory label: the unchanged candidate continues through order_dispatch.py, execution_guard.py, and the selected broker bridge without per-order human confirmation. The model cannot rewrite symbol, direction, size, entry, stop-loss, take-profit, strategy, or decision identity. It cannot resurrect a deterministic rejection or bypass any authority, risk, broker-truth, duplicate, recovery, or kill-switch gate. A paper-lane model outage may use the explicit degraded paper policy; a live-lane model or contract failure requires STAND_DOWN.
Model failure may degrade only on PAPER under explicit policy; LIVE model failure must STAND_DOWN.

Every immediate APPROVE or STAND_DOWN prompt must include current account balance, equity, margin, open positions, combined paper learning, the broker-verified MT5 demo subset, and candidate-specific realized outcomes for the same symbol, direction, and strategy. The prompt and durable report retain a context hash. One broker close observed through multiple audit paths counts once by broker_ticket plus decision_ref; richer metadata is merged rather than double-counted. Sparse evidence remains explicitly sparse. A prior loss requires materially differentiated regime or strategy evidence before repeated sampling, but one loss is not a permanent veto.
Broker-outcome binder and candidate-specific prompt context.
Deduplicate one broker close observed through multiple provenance paths.

Open-position management is not merely a fixed-rule subsystem labeled AI. Fresh broker position and quote truth first produce deterministic, broker-valid management drafts. The immediate AI Operator then selects one exact discretionary action per broker position or returns STAND_DOWN using current account truth, all open positions, owner guidance, owner-fenced controls, and realized outcome history. The model cannot rewrite broker ticket, symbol, side, volume, stop-loss, take-profit, or action identity. Baseline stop/target installation and high-urgency invalidation exits are non-vetoable policy actions. Every selected action still passes through order_dispatch.py, execution_guard.py, fresh broker truth, terminal permissions, duplicate suppression, and receipt reconciliation.
Natural broker-position decision/receipt proof remains OPEN while there are no actionable positions.

Autonomous management must consume the actual owner-fenced exit dials at action-draft time. trailing_stop_enabled=0 produces no trailing-stop draft. When enabled, trailing_lock_fraction determines the exact lock fraction and is retained in decision parameters and audit evidence. No hard-coded exit constant may silently override the Operator or owner control surface.
No hard-coded exit constant may silently override the Operator or owner control surface.
Live/real-capable entry must require fresh one-shot edge authorization where required.
Caps apply to paper and live; owner override wins, then AI dial, then config.
Open positions, exposure lots, floating loss, drawdown.
Loosening under armed real-money controls requires typed phrase.

Before broker touch, CAS uses broker trade_tick_value divided by trade_tick_size to value the exact entry-to-stop geometry in account currency. The higher of server geometry and any upstream expected-loss claim is authoritative.
Never let an AI/upstream risk field weaken the server-calculated broker stop risk; reject a per-trade cap breach before dispatch.

Every broker position with a protective stop exposes broker-valued entry-to-current-stop risk, remaining current-equity drawdown to the stop, the current per-trade cap, and any cap breach to the MT5 UI, ordinary Operator chat, and immediate Operator position management. This evidence does not itself force-close an already-open trade.
Keep admission risk, remaining-to-stop drawdown, and the observational no-forced-close boundary distinct.

A nonzero stale MT5 bid or ask must not keep the app labeled MARKET OPEN. Weekend, post-Friday-close, disabled-symbol, materially future, and stale tick evidence must fail closed. Protected open positions remain visible and supervised as WATCHING_MARKET_CLOSED while broker-side stops and targets remain in force; no fresh management action may be dispatched until executable quote truth returns.
Protected positions remain WATCHING_MARKET_CLOSED; require fresh executable quotes before any new management action.

The AI Operator owns an owner-fenced entry-timeframe dial. The autonomous scheduler rotates the enabled completed-candle lanes rather than silently fixing entries to one timeframe: M1 and M5 are the micro-scalp lane, while M15 and H1 are the broader intraday lane. Changing the dial changes which lanes may form candidates; it never bypasses edge, risk, quote, duplicate, recovery, execution-guard, or kill-switch requirements.
M1/M5 are micro-scalp lanes; M15/H1 are broader intraday lanes. Timeframe selection never bypasses gates.

Micro-scalp execution must be formed from current completed M1 or M5 broker candles, current bid/ask truth, and a direction derived from current market state. Historical replay templates, hard-coded LONG or SHORT direction, and default midpoint prices are research inputs only and cannot enter the broker-bound RouteIntent collector. Every fresh scalp candidate still requires immediate AI Operator APPROVE or STAND_DOWN before guarded dispatch.
Historical replay direction and default midpoint templates remain research-only.

Current quote truth is checked before a completed-candle candidate records or consumes its one-shot route identity. A missing, closed, unusable, stale, or materially future-dated quote produces no executable candidate and no emission key, so a weekend scan cannot waste the setup identity that may be valid after the market reopens.
Evaluate the setup afresh after executable quote truth returns.

When the owner asks why CAS did or did not trade, scalp, enter, close, or manage a position, the Operator leads with the exact current runtime state, selected timeframe lane, and immediate route blockers before broader strategy commentary. Public-launch, legal-review, or live-license state does not by itself block paper or demo execution and must not be presented as the paper/demo blocker unless runtime evidence says that gate actually fired.
Do not misstate public-launch or live-license readiness as a paper/demo execution blocker.

Observation-only chart and MT5 refresh work must not block the API event loop or the shared Operator-chat worker pool. Slow chart/provider work runs through an isolated bounded one-flight worker and returns stale or timeout telemetry without silencing normal Operator Ask traffic.
Keep the slow-chart event-loop regression and concurrent live poll probe.

The current governing workbook snapshot must be directly available to the Assistant and Operator. Its read-only status endpoint must not remain at WARMING because an unrelated dashboard, broker, or cache refresh is slow.
Require status=OK with Assistant and Operator prompt surfaces present.

Operator context percentage fields are expressed in percentage points, not decimal fractions. A value of 0.1 means 0.1%, never 10%. Chat and scheduled reasoning must receive this convention plus human-readable risk labels so the model cannot silently multiply a risk cap by 100 in owner-facing prose.
Keep ordinary-chat and scheduled-prompt regression tests; never rescale *_pct fields.
Owner can arm live/money switches in app; doing so grants standing autonomous authority but does not itself place a trade or transfer.
Autonomous execution still needs broker/provider, edge, risk, recovery, and telemetry gates to pass.
Fresh broker account/position truth is required before live dispatch, and action-time broker truth is authoritative over stale cached helpers.
execution_guard real telemetry checks and action-time broker-truth refresh.
Keep the focused dispatch suite in the release gate.
The AI may create, modify, trail, and execute take-profit logic as a first-class autonomous position-management action.
autonomous execution correction; ai hedge management execution path.
Keep management execution receipts and refresh evidence visible in chat/UI.

New-entry symbol filtering must occur before route ranking. The owner-fenced AI symbol dial defines the base universe; an optional scheduler subset may narrow it, and per-symbol position caps remove saturated markets from new entries only. Existing saturated positions remain under autonomous management. Targeting provenance, effective symbols, eligible symbols, and saturation reasons must be visible and durably audited.
Owner-fenced symbols, optional scheduler subset, position caps, durable targeting provenance.
Saturated symbols remain under management while being excluded from new entries.

An external MT5 terminal is not automatically live money. Every outcome and provenance record must distinguish external_broker_terminal from account_mode and live_money. A positively identified demo account is PAPER_MT5 in the MT5_DEMO_BROKER lane and must not consume live-pilot capacity. Historical misclassifications are corrected by immutable appended evidence; original records are not rewritten.
Execution provenance and immutable correction events.
Never consume live-pilot capacity for a positively identified demo account.

Every closed CAS MT5 demo position must join the originating AI decision and finalized order attempt by exact broker position ticket. The join retains decision_ref, order_id, strategy, direction, timeframe, gross profit, commission, swap, close reason, and normalized broker timestamps. Repeated syncs are idempotent. A history read with zero identity matches must be reported as unbound, not as completed learning.
A history read with zero identity matches must report unbound.

Critical-notification audit rows are immutable history, but transient blocked attempts must not appear forever as current active conditions.
